sections.title: Emotions & Moods
sections.description: This course will provide a comprehensive introduction to emotions and moods from the integrated perspective of the brain and mind. We will begin with a survey of concepts related to emotions and moods, including how they are measured and manipulated. We will then explore emotion and mood theories. We will end with an exploration of healthy emotion and mood regulation, as well as emotion- and mood-related conditions such as depression and anxiety.
